text: In a first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence, the differential $d_r$ on the $E_r$ page maps $E_r^{p,q}$ to:
explanation: By definition $d_r$ sends $E_r^{p,q}$ to $E_r^{p+r,q-r+1}$: right by $r$, down by $r-1$, raising total degree by $1$. A map to $E_r^{p+1,q}$ is a double-complex horizontal differential, not $d_r$; $E_r^{p-r,q+r-1}$ is the source of the incoming $d_r$ (arrow reversed); and $E_r^{p+r-1,q-r}$ simply has the wrong bidegree.
